description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing and retrieving match highlights in a sports live-stream platform. It uses FastAPI to create async API routes for listing highlights, fetching details of a specific highlight, and getting featured highlights. It interacts with a database through a repository pattern, handles authentication optionally, and converts database models to response schemas.

methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of match highlights with optional filtering by match ID, returning a response containing highlights and pagination info.

methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific highlight by ID, increments its view count, and returns the highlight data.
